notes: Posted 29 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start-(7)': Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation ('QMC/IO'), Bespin, Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber, Heading For The Medical Frigate ('HFTMF'), Insurrection, Strike Planning and Squadron Assignments ('Squad Assignments'); these count toward the 60.

The same seven cards are listed again in their sections marked '(S)' (HFTMF (S), Insurrection(S), Strike Planning(S), Squad Asignments(S), Bespin(S), Carbonite Chamber(S)) and the Objective again at the end as 'QMC/IA'; these repeats are not counted twice. Counted once each, the list totals 60 (the 'Interrupts-(18)' header includes the repeated HFTMF; its rows add to 17 without it).

Posted 'Puccimir Thryss' dested Pucumir Thryss; 'Devorian' Devaronian; 'Millenium Falcon' Millennium Falcon; 'Artoo in Red 5' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Nar Shudda Wind Chimes' Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes; 'Control/ Tunnel Vision' Control & Tunnel Vision; 'DODN/WA' Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice (a 2001 Effect); 'Cloud City' the Light Bespin: Cloud City site.
Posted 'CCDB 327' dested Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay), the Light Cloud City docking bay.
Posted 'DB' (sites) is kept as written (UNKNOWN): no card is named. The strategy says to 'Deploy a DB with Insurrection'.
Posted 'East Platform' is kept as written (UNKNOWN): Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) is a Dark card only and cannot be in a Light deck.
Author name 'Fred "DMX69" Durst' is a celebrity's name; credited by handle only, no person page (Bill's prank-name rule; as DeckTech 22351).
